decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing had its own page in both years and serves as a platform component across the drain families, so it likely meets aspirations and costs little to keep.
The floor-level shower drainage line moved from a mention to its own page and fits the core strategic direction toward low-profile accessible bathrooms, which signals performance above aspiration.

The designer flagship slipped from its own page to a mere mention, which hints at some shortfall, but it is central to the firm's design positioning, and slack in the established business lets the firm keep it while searching for improvements.
The shower element with integrated slope received only modest visibility, yet it complements the integrated low-profile system strategy and the renovation boom, so a drop is not yet warranted.
The DallSafe 200 backflow cellar drain was promoted to the home page, which suggests strong results, and rising flood-protection demand supports keeping it.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral, low-profile line with only mentions, making it the most likely candidate for pruning, but as a cheap catalog complement it will probably be retained.
